answer_1.quote: The potential effectiveness of counterspeech as a hate speech mitigation strategy has motivated an increasing interest in Natural Language Generation (NLG) research towards the automation of its production.
answer_1.outputs: counterspeech texts generated in response to hate speech

answer_2.quote: we employ the following automatic metrics: Repetition Rate (RR) measures the lexical repetitiveness of a text... Safety Score (SAF)... ArgJudge (ArgJ) is a BERT model trained on human scores on counter-arguments quality...

answer_4.quote: We recruited 17 graduate-level volunteer annotators for one hour, where they were given a brief presentation introducing the task, annotation guidelines, and annotated examples.
answer_4.guideline: annotators scored each CS across these four dimensions: Cogency (COG), Suitableness (SUI), Relevance (REL), and Informativeness (INF) on a 1-5 Likert scale
